private.name: Walden Robotics

data.narrative:
Westmag is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by David Hansen and Jordan Sanders. The company has raised $11M to date. The robotics and manufacturing sector contains 9 comparable private companies and 1 public reference point, though the narrow peer set at Westmag's stage and valuation tier is limited.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method. Using total capital raised of $11M as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $28M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied; while 11 same-sector companies exist, fewer than three meet strict filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce unwarranted noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, with a central point of $28M. Key uncertainties include the narrow comparables universe at this stage and valuation tier, which limits cross-validation of the stage-progression multiple. Additionally, recent fundraising activity, burn rate trajectory, and product-market validation metrics—unavailable in this dataset—would meaningfully refine this range. Further diligence on competitive positioning within the 9-company private peer set is warranted before final recommendation.
